text: Male or female subjects between 18 and 75 years of age (inclusive).
Have been diagnosed with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM) for at least 3 months based on the World Health Organization criteria
sub_conditions: Diagnosis of T2DM per WHO criteria

text: Participants treated with a stable dose of metformin (maintenance dose of at least 1500 mg/day or a maximally tolerated dose not less than 1000 mg) for at least 8 weeks prior to screening; and must be stable for at least 12 weeks prior to randomization.
sub_conditions: Stable metformin dose for ≥8 weeks prior to screening
Metformin dose ≥1500 mg/day or maximally tolerated dose ≥1000 mg
Stable for ≥12 weeks prior to randomization

text: HbA1c ≥7.5% and ≤11.0% at screening as assessed by the local laboratory
HbA1c ≥7.5% and ≤11.0% prior to randomization as assessed by the specified central laboratory.
needed_info: lab: HbA1c (central lab, prior to randomization)

text: Having a body mass index (BMI) of 19.0 to 40.0 kg/m2, inclusive.

Female participants of childbearing potential and male participants must agree to use highly effective contraception method from the day of signing the ICF and until 30 days (female) or 90 days (male) after the final dose administration.
sub_conditions: Agree to use highly effective contraception (females of childbearing potential and males)
Contraception from ICF signing until 30 days (female) or 90 days (male) after final dose

text: Able to understand and comply with protocol requirements, agree to maintain the same dietary and exercise habits throughout the trial, be willing to complete the trial in strict compliance with the clinical trial protocol and provide written informed consent.
sub_conditions: Able to understand and comply with protocol requirements
Agree to maintain same dietary and exercise habits throughout trial
Willing to complete trial in compliance with protocol

text: Diagnosed with type 1 diabetes mellitus (including latent autoimmune diabetes in adults), special types of diabetes or gestational diabetes mellitus
Evidence of acute complications of diabetes (e.g., diabetic ketoacidosis, diabetic lactosidosis, or hyperosmolar nonketotic coma) within 6 months prior to signing the informed consent form (ICF).
sub_conditions: Other acute diabetes complications within 6 months
needed_info: medical history: acute diabetic complications and dates

text: Have a known self or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma, thyroid C-cell hyperplasia or multiple endocrine neoplasia type II (MEN2)
sub_conditions: Personal or family history of medullary thyroid carcinoma
Personal or family history of thyroid C-cell hyperplasia
Personal or family history of MEN2

text: History of acute or chronic pancreatitis or pancreatic injury, or any high-risk factor which may lead to pancreatitis
Symptomatic gallbladder disease that requires treatment during the trial (subjects with prior cholecystectomy can be enrolled if deemed eligible by the investigator)
sub_conditions: Symptomatic gallbladder disease requiring treatment during trial
Exception: prior cholecystectomy if investigator deems eligible

text: Have had dysphagia, or any condition or disease possibly affecting gastric emptying or nutrients absorption in the opinion of the investigator, such as history of surgery affecting gastric emptying, gastroesophageal reflux disease, pyloric obstruction, irritable bowel syndrome, etc.
sub_conditions: Other condition affecting gastric emptying or nutrient absorption per investigator

text: Unstable angina within 3 months prior to screening
sub_conditions: Unstable angina within 3 months prior to screening

text: Heart failure (NYHA class III or IV) within 3 months prior to screening
sub_conditions: Heart failure NYHA III or IV within 3 months prior to screening

text: Myocardial infarction within 3 months prior to screening
sub_conditions: MI within 3 months prior to screening

text: Coronary artery bypass grafting or percutaneous coronary intervention within 3 months prior to screening

Uncontrolled severe arrhythmias within 3 months prior to screening (including ventricular tachycardia, ventricular fibrillation, atrial fibrillation, second to third degree atrioventricular block, sick sinus node syndrome, pre-excitation syndrome, etc.)
sub_conditions: Second to third degree AV block
needed_info: arrhythmia history with dates and control status

text: Cerebrovascular accident within 3 months prior to screening
sub_conditions: Cerebrovascular accident within 3 months prior to screening

text: Have a history of proliferative diabetic retinopathy and/or diabetic maculopathy that requires treatment, or evidence of other severe retinopathy that requires treatment during the study.
sub_conditions: Other severe retinopathy requiring treatment during study

text: Have a known history of liver disease, including: acute or chronic active liver disease (except non-alcoholic steatohepatitis) such as active hepatitis B, hepatitis C; or primary biliary cholangitis.
sub_conditions: Acute or chronic active liver disease (except NASH)

text: Used strong CYP3A4 or P-gp inhibitors within 14 days prior to randomization or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer)
sub_conditions: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitor use within 14 days or 5 half-lives prior to randomization
Strong P-gp inhibitor use within 14 days or 5 half-lives prior to randomization

text: Current use with strong/moderate CYP3A4 inhibitors or strong P-gp inducers that cannot be discontinued during the trial
sub_conditions: Current strong/moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor that cannot be discontinued
Current strong P-gp inducer that cannot be discontinued

text: Any prior use of OATP1B1/OATP1B3 inhibitors
Current use of narrow therapeutic index drugs that are substrates of CYP2C8, CYP3A4, UGT1A1, P-gp, or OATP1B1/OATP1B3 and cannot be discontinued during the trial.
sub_conditions: Narrow therapeutic index substrate of CYP2C8

text: Use of any glucose-lowering medication within 4 weeks prior to signing the ICF, including but not limited to α-glucosidase inhibitors (e.g., acarbose), thiazolidinediones, DPP-4 inhibitors, glucokinase activators, SGLT-2 inhibitors, with the exception of short-term insulin therapy due to a concomitant illness, stress, or perioperative period (cumulative duration ≤ 7 days).
sub_conditions: Other glucose-lowering medication (other than metformin per protocol) within 4 weeks
Exception: short-term insulin ≤7 days cumulative for illness, stress or perioperative

text: Having used a GLP-1 analogue within 3 months prior to signing the ICF
sub_conditions: GLP-1 analogue use within 3 months prior to ICF

text: Previous discontinuation of a GLP-1 analogue due to safety/tolerability or lack of efficacy.
sub_conditions: Prior GLP-1 analogue discontinuation due to safety/tolerability
Prior GLP-1 analogue discontinuation due to lack of efficacy

text: Pregnancy or lactation.
Subjects with a known hypersensitivity to SGLT-2i or GLP-1 receptor agonists (GLP-1RA), or a history of severe drug allergies.
sub_conditions: Known hypersensitivity to GLP-1 receptor agonists

text: Enrolled in or participated in any other clinical study of drugs or medical devices within 3 months (or within 5 half-lives, whichever is longer) prior to signing the ICF (except for subjects who signed written informed consent without any intervention of investigational product or medical devices).
sub_conditions: Participation in another drug or device study within 3 months or 5 half-lives (whichever is longer) prior to ICF
Exception: signed consent without receiving any investigational product or device
needed_info: clinical trial participation history with dates

text: Any other condition considered by the investigator which is not suitable for participating in this study.
